decisions.what: Static UI mockup, not CRUD; route stays view('welcome')

decisions.alternative_rejected: DB-backed welcome list via TodoRepository/Service (out of scope)

decisions.what: Restrict all Tailwind classes to those in the pre-compiled inline <style> bundle
decisions.why: no public/build exists, so only bundled utilities render
decisions.alternative_rejected: using arbitrary Tailwind classes that would render unstyled

decisions.what: Completed badge border uses bundled border-[#e3e3e0] dark:border-[#3E3E3A] with red text
decisions.why: border-[#f53003]/dark:border-[#FF4433] are absent from the bundle (would fall back to currentColor)
decisions.alternative_rejected: keeping the un-bundled red border classes
